text: I began my M.S. studies in Computer Science at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign and joined the [Illinois NSAI Lab](https://github.com/illinois-nsai).
I completed a B.S. in Mathematics (Honors) at the University of Michigan.
I worked as a research assistant in the [Human-AI Lab](https://guoanhong.com/), contributing to multimodal gaze tracking and HCI research.
